ops.title: cc-sync phase2c final acceptance @27b1761: e2e 19/19, realproc pass (G1/G2 skip), native pass after fixture fix a30cb9f
ops.body:
Acceptance of cc-sync/phase2c @ 27b1761d0ddd2d27271ff9bdc80afb339a61e785, GOWORK=off, pinned modules confirmed by `go list -m`: synckit v0.39.3-0.20260927015715-4334f0dd3914, reposync v0.30.2-0.20260927021559-a16167684fde. Logs: /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/deps/logs/*-27b1761-final.log.

1. E2E (`go test -tags e2e -race -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/e2e/ -v`, git-lfs /opt/homebrew/bin/git-lfs): 19/19 top-level PASS, 0 FAIL/SKIP, 0 DATA RACE, ok 125.898s.
2. Realproc, REALPROC_SYNCKIT=deps/synckit-final2 (4334f0dd), REALPROC_OLD_SYNCKIT=synckit cc-sync-recovery (9014672): TestRealProcessHost PASS, TestInstallWithoutSynckitd PASS, TestVersionSkewOldSynckitd PASS, TestCrossHostDelivery (G2) SKIP, TestInstallProbeRace (G1) SKIP; ok 2.909s. Same with REALPROC_SYNCKIT unset (go.mod pin): same outcomes, ok 2.276s. No /private/tmp/ccs.* roots, claude scratch dirs, or synckitd.real processes left; the process list matched the pre-run baseline.
3. Native (claude 2.1.283, already logged in via claude.ai, no auth prompts): the first full run FAILED TestNativeAcceptance/cross-cwd.../relocated_artifacts_are_readable. Haiku answered "SPILL: row 0399 ..." instead of SPILL-END-<nonce>, but its Read of the relocated tool-results file succeeded and contained the marker. A second cross-cwd-only run reproduced it. Root cause was the test fixture, not cc-sync: a final line named SPILL-END reads as an end sentinel, not as output. Fixed forward in a30cb9f (the token now rides a regular last row, `row 0400 TAILTOKEN-<nonce>`), pushed to cc-sync/phase2c. After the fix, the cross-cwd-only run PASSED and the full native run PASSED: TestNativeAcceptance PASS (cross-config-root SKIP NOT-COVERED, CC_SYNC_ACCEPT_CONFIG_DIR unset) and TestNativeResume 9/9 PASS. Acceptance -p spend: $0.4041 + $0.3116 + $0.2916 + $0.3296 = $1.3369. TestNativeResume spend is not metered in the log. No /private/tmp/cc-sync-accept-* roots or accept project dirs were left behind.
